questions.question: In which year was the PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) scheme launched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2019.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The PM-KUSUM scheme was launched in March 2019 to provide energy and water security to farmers through solar power.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scheme aims to add a solar capacity of 34,800 MW by March 2026 with a total Central Financial Support of ₹34,422 crore.**
 
• It is designed to "de-dieselize" the agricultural sector by replacing diesel pumps with solar-powered irrigation systems.
 
• The MNRE recently extended the completion timeline for select projects under this scheme to **March 31, 2027**.
 
• PM-KUSUM Components__
 __
 
• Component A - 10,000 MW of Decentralized Ground Mounted Grid Connected Renewable Power Plants.
 
• Component B - Installation of 20 lakh Stand-alone Solar Agriculture Pumps.
 
• Component C - Solarisation of 15 lakh Grid-connected Agriculture Pumps.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• MNRE (Ministry of New and Renewable Energy)__

 __
 
• Nodal Ministry for all matters relating to new and renewable energy.
 
• Current Union Minister - Pralhad Joshi.
 
 
 
• CFA (Central Financial Assistance)__
 __
 
• The government provides 30% subsidy in general states and up to 50% in North Eastern and Hilly regions.
 
 
 
• PM-KUSUM 2.0__
 
 
• The government is currently formulating an upgraded framework to further enhance the reach and impact of the solarization drive.

questions.question: Under the extended PM E-DRIVE scheme, what is the new subsidy expiration date for Electric Two-Wheelers (e2w)?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revised Timelines:**

 
 
• **Electric Two-Wheelers (e2w):** Extended until **July 31, 2026**.

• __**Budget:**__ Approximately **₹1,259.91 crore** is approved specifically for the electric two-wheeler segment.
 
• __**Industry Request:**__ The extension follows requests from **SIAM** and manufacturers like Bajaj Auto, Hero MotoCorp, and TVS to ensure full fund utilization.

questions.question: According to India’s Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) for the period 2031-2035 approved by the Cabinet, what is the target for reducing the Emissions Intensity of GDP by 2035 compared to the 2005 level?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**47 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, approved India’s updated Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) for the 2031-2035 period.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Emissions Intensity Target:** India has committed to reducing the Emissions Intensity of its GDP by 47 percent by 2035, using the 2005 level as the baseline.
 
• **Non-Fossil Fuel Capacity:** The new NDC aims for 60 percent cumulative electric power installed capacity from non-fossil fuel-based energy resources by 2035.
 
• **Carbon Sink Goal:** India plans to create an additional carbon sink of 3.5 to 4.0 billion tonnes of Carbon dioxide equivalent through enhanced forest and tree cover by 2035.
 
• **Long-term Vision:** These targets align with the goal of achieving Net-Zero emissions by 2070 and the broader vision of Viksit Bharat @2047.
 
• Implementation Framework__
 __
 
• Strategic Schemes - Green Hydrogen Mission, PM Surya Ghar, and PLI schemes.
 
• Adaptation - MISHTI initiative for mangroves and GLOF monitoring for the Himalayas.
 
• International Roles - Leadership in ISA, CDRI, and Global Bio-fuel Alliance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)__

 __
 
• NDCs are non-binding national plans highlighting climate actions, including targets for greenhouse gas emission reductions, under the UNFCCC Paris Agreement.
 
 
 
• Emissions Intensity__
 __
 
• This is the volume of emissions per unit of GDP. Reducing it means the economy is becoming more energy-efficient and less carbon-dependent while continuing to grow.
 
 
 
• Net-Zero Emissions__
 __
 
• A state in which the greenhouse gases going into the atmosphere are balanced by removal out of the atmosphere. India aims to reach this by 2070.
 
 
 
• CBDR-RC__
 
 
• Common But Differentiated Responsibilities and Respective Capabilities is a principle within the UNFCCC that acknowledges different capabilities and differing responsibilities of individual countries in addressing climate change.

questions.question: Under the newly launched Credit Guarantee Scheme for Microfinance Institutions 2.0 (CGSMFI-2.0), what is the guarantee coverage provided for Small MFIs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**80%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India launched Credit Guarantee Scheme for Microfinance Institutions 2.0 (CGSMFI-2.0) to enhance credit flow to small borrowers and stabilize the microfinance sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tiered Coverage:** The scheme provides **80%** guarantee for Small MFIs, **75%** for Medium MFIs, and **70%** for Large MFIs.
 
• **Target Reach:** It aims to benefit approximately **36 lakh small borrowers** at the bottom of the economic pyramid.
 
• **Financial Cap:** The scheme is valid until **30 June 2026** or until **₹20,000 crore** in loans are guaranteed.
 
• **Interest Rates:** Lending rates are capped at EBLR/MCLR + 2% for MFIs to ensure affordable credit.
 
• **Implementation:** The guarantees are backed by the **National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company Limited (NCGTC)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **What is an MFI?__**

__
 
• Microfinance Institutions__

 
 
• **Microfinance Institutions (MFIs)** are financial companies that provide small loans to people who do not have access to banking services. These are typically low-income individuals or groups in rural and semi-urban areas. In India, they are regulated by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) 2.0 and choose the correct one (s):

1. The mission has been extended to December 2028.

2. It introduces a unique 'Sujal Gaon ID' for digital mapping from source to tap.

3. The total revised outlay for the mission is Rs. 8.69 lakh crore.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**All 1, 2 & 3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet has approved Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)2.0, extending the mission timeline and significantly increasing the budget.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Extension:** The implementation period is now extended to **December 2028** to cover all 19.36 crore rural households.
 
• **Digital Framework:** Under **Sujalam Bharat**, a unique **Sujal Gaon / Service Area ID** will be assigned to every village for digital tracking.
 
• **Financials:** The total outlay stands at **Rs. 8.69 lakh crore**, with the Center contributing Rs. 3.59 lakh crore.
 
• **Strategy Shift:** JJM 2.0 moves from infrastructure creation to a **utility-based service delivery** approach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Health Impact__

 __
 
• WHO estimates that JJM can prevent **4 lakh diarrheal deaths**, and Nobel laureate Michael Kremer suggests it could reduce under-five mortality by 30%.
 
 
 
• Community Engagement__
 
 
• Programs like **Jal Arpan** (handover to Panchayats) and **Jal Utsav** (community maintenance) ensure the sustainability of the water supply.

questions.question: Mission Basundhara 3.0 is primarily associated with which of the following sectors in Assam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Land Revenue and Records.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Launch:** Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma** launched Mission Basundhara 3.0 in Guwahati, continuing the state's flagship initiative for land reforms.
 
• **Evolution:** This is the third phase of the mission, following the successful implementation of Basundhara 1.0 (2021) and Basundhara 2.0 (2023–2024).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Features of Mission Basundhara 3.0__**

__
 
• **New Digital Services:** The portal now allows online application and delivery of land revenue receipts, **land classification certificates**, jamabandi copies, and mouza maps.
 
• **Digital Mutation:** It enables faster **name transfer (mutation)** for inherited or sold land with significantly reduced processing timelines.
 
• **Portal Integration:** The mission is integrated with **Dharitri** (Assam’s land records portal) for real-time verification and updates.
 
• **Specific Land Focus:** Phase 3.0 includes a special focus on the settlement of **tea garden land**, government land settlement, and the removal of encroachments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Technology & Citizen Welfare__**

 
• **Advanced Tech:** The upgraded system uses **GIS mapping, drone surveys**, and **blockchain pilots** to ensure that land records are tamper-proof and highly accurate.
 
• **Paperless Governance:** By using **Aadhaar-linked authentication** and **DigiLocker integration**, the mission promotes a paperless and transparent environment.
 
• **Accessibility:** The government has committed to **doorstep delivery** of services in remote and hilly areas to ensure inclusive governance.
 
• **Accountability:** A grievance redressal mechanism with fixed timelines and **SMS/email tracking** has been established to resolve citizen complaints.

questions.question: Under the Banglar Yuva Sathi Scheme 2026, how much monthly financial assistance will eligible unemployed youth receive?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1,500 per month.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The West Bengal Government launched the Banglar Yuva Sathi Scheme 2026 to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth in the state.**
 
• **The scheme rollout was advanced to April 1, 2026, with applications opening on February 15, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eligible youth will receive ₹1,500 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).**
 
• **Financial assistance will be provided for up to 5 years or until the beneficiary secures employment or self-employment.**
 
• **Eligibility age group is 21–40 years, with minimum qualification of Madhyamik (Class 10) pass.**
 
• **The scheme is administered by the Department of Sports and Youth Services with an initial budget allocation of ₹5,000 crore.**
 
• **Estimated beneficiaries may reach 27.8 lakh, with projected total expenditure exceeding ₹27,750 crore in the coming fiscal period.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** A government mechanism for transferring subsidies and financial assistance directly into beneficiaries’ Aadhaar-linked bank accounts to reduce leakages.
 
• **Madhyamik Examination:** Secondary school (Class 10) examination conducted by the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education.
 
• **Vote-on-Account:** A temporary budget provision allowing government expenditure until the full budget is passed.
 
• **Eligibility Conditions:** Applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal, unemployed, not availing other government social security benefits (except scholarships), and must possess an Aadhaar-linked bank account.
 
• **Objective:** To provide interim financial relief to jobseekers while encouraging employment and self-employment opportunities.

questions.question: Under the revamped Prime Minister Internship Scheme announced in March 2026, what is the new monthly stipend amount provided to interns?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹9,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India announced a major revamp of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme in March 2026 to boost youth employability.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Financial Incentive:** To reduce drop-out rates, the monthly stipend has been increased from **₹5,000 to ₹9,000**.
 
• **Age Revision:** The eligibility age bracket has been widened, with the minimum age reduced to **18 years** and the maximum increased to **25 years**.
 
• **Academic Scope:** The scheme now allows candidates with **Postgraduate and MBA degrees** to apply, which was previously restricted.
 
• **Corporate Base:** The requirement for companies to have **CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility)** mandates has been removed to expand the number of participating firms.
 
• **Target:** Phase 3 of the scheme aims to provide **1,00,000 internship opportunities** across 19 different sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **CSR Mandate__**

__
 
• Corporate Social Responsibility__

 
 
• **CSR** refers to the legal requirement under the Companies Act, 2013, for certain profitable companies to spend 2% of their average net profit on social welfare activities. By removing this as a prerequisite for the internship scheme, the government has enabled smaller but high-growth firms to mentor youth.

questions.question: In which of the following years did the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, approve the Revised Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM) to boost growth in the livestock sector?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Union Cabinet**, chaired by the Prime Minister **Shri Narendra Modi**, approved the **Revised Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)** in **2025** to boost growth in the livestock sector. This mission aims to enhance the overall productivity and genetic improvement of bovines.
 
• The **Rashtriya Gokul Mission** was initially launched in **2014** with the objective of **conserving and developing indigenous breeds** of cattle in a scientific and holistic manner.
 
• The revised mission in **2025** focuses on strengthening the dairy sector and improving **animal health**, quality breeding, and milk production to achieve self-sufficiency in dairy production. *Hence, the correct year is 2025.*
 
• **Livestock sector** plays a crucial role in India’s economy, contributing significantly to **agricultural GDP**. The revised mission aligns with the broader goals of increasing farmers’ income and ensuring food security.
 
• The mission promotes the use of **advanced technologies**, such as embryo transfer techniques and artificial insemination, to ensure better breeding practices and increase productivity. *This is a significant step towards improving livestock management.*
 
• The approval in **2025** reflects the government’s renewed commitment to enhancing the dairy and livestock sectors, which are vital for rural development and economic growth.
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is 2025.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Gokul Mission:**

 
 
• Launched in **2014**, the Rashtriya Gokul Mission focuses on the conservation and development of **indigenous bovine breeds**.
 
• The mission emphasizes improving **genetic resources** and promoting the use of **advanced breeding technologies**.
 
• The revised mission integrates modern technology with traditional practices to ensure the growth of the livestock sector.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Livestock Sector:**
 
 
• Livestock contributes around **4.5% to India’s GDP** and provides livelihood to millions of farmers and rural households.
 
• It plays a critical role in **food security**, rural development, and poverty alleviation.
 
• The Revised RGM aims to address challenges like **low productivity**, poor health, and genetic improvement of bovines.
 
 
 
• **Government’s Role:**
 
 
• The government has been proactive in enhancing the dairy sector through various programs like **National Dairy Plan (NDP)** and Rashtriya Gokul Mission.
 
• The approval of Revised RGM in **2025** aligns with the vision of doubling farmers’ income and ensuring rural prosperity.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Breeding Technologies:**

 
 
• The mission promotes **embryo transfer techniques** and **artificial insemination** to enhance genetic resources.
 
• It ensures the use of modern tools to improve the quality and quantity of milk production.
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact:**
 
 
• The Revised RGM supports the goal of achieving self-sufficiency in **milk production** and reducing dependency on imports.
 
• It contributes to rural development by creating **employment opportunities** and enhancing farmers’ income.
